_note: Models under test. Adding one is an entry here, not a code change. Every id must exist in harness/pricing/catalog.json — refresh that with harness/pricing/fetch.mjs after adding.
_brackets: Brackets are drawn from modelled cost per run at the OBSERVED token mix (96% cache reads), not from headline in/out pricing, which describes a different workload. The boundary sits in a natural 1.5x gap in the data rather than at a round number.

pi.description: Neutral coding agent (@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent) driving every model over OpenRouter. The control scaffold for experiment A — the only one that spans all providers, so it is the only one that can isolate the model.

claude-code.description: Anthropic's own agent scaffold via the `claude` CLI. Anthropic models only, so it cannot serve experiment A. Kept for experiment B, where the model is held fixed and the scaffold varies.

A-models.question: Which model is better at this task?

B-scaffold.question: How much of a vendor's coding performance is the model versus their own scaffold?

models.disabled_reason: Only model dearer than Sonnet (1.26x). Answers a secondary question — does paying more help — not the primary one.

models.note: Frontier anchor, and the fixed model for experiment B — the only model both scaffolds can drive.

models.disabled_reason: Frontier slot already covered by Sonnet and gemini-flash; adds a price cliff that complicates attribution.

models.note: Sits on the bracket boundary at ~0.5x Sonnet. The most informative single point: if it holds up, the frontier bracket is hard to justify.
Top of the economy bracket. Where the cheap tier is most likely to still be adequate.

models.disabled_reason: Economy slot covered by glm-5.2 and deepseek-flash; same long-context re-pricing complication.
Modelled cost is within 6% of deepseek-v4-flash ($0.056 vs $0.053) — same family, same price band, redundant for a first pass.

models.note: Economy floor, ~18x cheaper than Sonnet. Establishes where quality actually collapses.

_reduced: Reduced to four: one representative per price band, no two from the same family. Disabled entries are kept with their reason so the selection is visible rather than implied — a suite that quietly drops models reads as coverage it does not have.
